metadata.value: **Streaming video model** is a general video model, which is applicable to general video understanding tasks. Traditionally, video understanding tasks have been modeled by two separate architectures, specially tailored for two distinct tasks. Streaming video model is the first deep learning architecture that unifies video understanding tasks. We build an instance of streaming video model, namely the streaming video Transformer (S-ViT).
